verification.notes: The source clip records Trump saying Venezuela had worked out well, that millions of barrels had gone to Houston and Louisiana, and that refineries were running around the clock and making money. Current EIA data and reporting confirm sharply increased Venezuelan crude imports into Gulf Coast refineries, led by Texas and Louisiana.
